_comment: Evidence class M (measurement, not proof). GitHub Actions run 39549194822 (workflow drivers.yml, windows-2022, MSVC Release x64, GMP 6.2.1-4, 1000 iterations per line); a hosted shared runner, so absolute values differ from the author's machine. The verification lines before the AES timings were '0 0 0' for AES-128 (the straight-line graph variant generated by python/virt.py graph_to_c equals the C reference, L09) and '0 1 0' for AES-192 and AES-256 (their straight-line graph variants are not generated; the stubs leave the output unchanged, L02). The RSA verification lines were '0 0 0 0' for 32..256 bits.
